enabled.description: 是否启用 QQ 远程申请登录。

public_login_enabled.description: 是否允许非主人用户申请登录；由主人指令和面板 Remote API 统一控制。

server_url.description: AstrBot-Deploy Web 面板地址，例如 http://server-ip:7070。

remote_token.description: Remote API token. It must match remote_api_token in /opt/astrbot/panel_config.json.

owner_ids.description: QQ users allowed to run owner commands. Empty means nobody.

bot_self_ids.description: Bot QQ accounts allowed to respond. Empty means no bot responds.

allowed_groups.description: Allowed group IDs. Empty means no group limit.

qr_retry_seconds.description: Seconds before the same user can request a fresh QR code again. Default 60 seconds.
